name: Eris
description: Eris, the secretary: her status poses, a conversation typed to her, and the soul text and orb other plugins reuse.

endue.eris.shortcut.description: The shortcut that brings endue forward and opens the talk line (Option+Enter on macOS). With endue in front, it toggles the talk line. DESK_ERIS_SHORTCUT overrides it. Talk to Eris in the tray works with any shortcut.
